summary: 33-year-old female from Arvada found deceased: body discovered by park visitors late Friday afternoon June 18 in the drainage below the outlet of The Loch; rangers could not reach the site Friday night (lightning/darkness) and field ops were hampered by weather Saturday; on Sunday June 20 a 38-member RMNP SAR team (28 in the field) extricated the body up ~60 ft through steep rocky terrain to the Loch Vale Trail and wheeled it by litter to Glacier Gorge Trailhead; transferred to the Larimer County Coroner; incident date and mechanism unknown, investigation ongoing
location: The Loch outlet drainage, Rocky Mountain National Park
